sentences.text: The boat was rushing upwards in a smooth and unceasing motion.
sentences.read: The boat was rushing upwards in a smooth and unceasing motion.

sentences.text: The incline was over thirty degrees.
sentences.read: The incline was over thirty degrees.

sentences.text: I could feel myself being pulled down towards the stern.
sentences.read: I could feel myself being pulled down towards the stern.

sentences.text: Twisting my hand frantically, I succeeded in catching one more hook with the rope.
sentences.read: Twisting my hand frantically, I succeeded in catching one more hook with the rope.

sentences.text: It was the best I could do.
sentences.read: It was the best I could do.

sentences.text: This was not a job meant to be done from the inside of the lifeboat but from the outside.
sentences.read: This was not a job meant to be done from the inside of the lifeboat but from the outside.

sentences.text: I pulled hard on the rope, something made easier by the fact that holding on to it was preventing me from sliding down the length of the boat.
sentences.read: I pulled hard on the rope, something made easier by the fact that holding on to it was preventing me from sliding down the length of the boat.

sentences.text: The boat swiftly passed a forty-five-degree incline.
sentences.read: The boat swiftly passed a forty-five-degree incline.

sentences.text: We must have been at a sixty-degree incline when we reached the summit of the swell and broke through its crest onto the other side.
sentences.read: We must have been at a sixty-degree incline when we reached the summit of the swell and broke through its crest onto the other side.

sentences.text: The smallest portion of the swell’s supply of water crashed down on us.
sentences.read: The smallest portion of the swell's supply of water crashed down on us.

sentences.text: I felt as if I were being pummelled (反复猛击) by a great fist.
sentences.read: I felt as if I were being pummelled by a great fist.

sentences.text: The lifeboat abruptly tilted forward and everything was reversed: I was now at the lower end of the lifeboat, and the water that had swamped it, with a tiger soaking in it, came my way.
sentences.read: The lifeboat abruptly tilted forward and everything was reversed: I was now at the lower end of the lifeboat, and the water that had swamped it, with a tiger soaking in it, came my way.

sentences.text: I did not feel the tiger—I had no precise idea of where Richard Parker was; it was pitch-black beneath the tarpaulin—but before we reached the next valley I was half-drowned.
sentences.read: I did not feel the tiger—I had no precise idea of where Richard Parker was; it was pitch-black beneath the tarpaulin—but before we reached the next valley I was half-drowned.

sentences.text: For the rest of that day and into the night, we went up and down, up and down, up and down, until terror became monotonous and was replaced by numbness and a complete giving-up.
sentences.read: For the rest of that day and into the night, we went up and down, up and down, up and down, until terror became monotonous and was replaced by numbness and a complete giving-up.

sentences.text: I held on to the tarpaulin rope with one hand and the edge of the bow bench with the other, while my body lay flat against the side bench.
sentences.read: I held on to the tarpaulin rope with one hand and the edge of the bow bench with the other, while my body lay flat against the side bench.

sentences.text: In this position—water pouring in, water pouring out—the tarpaulin beat me to a pulp, I was soaked and chilled, and I was bruised and cut by bones and turtle shells.
sentences.read: In this position—water pouring in, water pouring out—the tarpaulin beat me to a pulp, I was soaked and chilled, and I was bruised and cut by bones and turtle shells.

sentences.text: The noise of the storm was constant, as was Richard Parker’s snarling.
sentences.read: The noise of the storm was constant, as was Richard Parker's snarling.

sentences.text: Sometime during the night my mind noted that the storm was over.
sentences.read: Sometime during the night my mind noted that the storm was over.

sentences.text: We were bobbing on the sea in a normal way.
sentences.read: We were bobbing on the sea in a normal way.

sentences.text: Through a tear in the tarpaulin I glimpsed the night sky.
sentences.read: Through a tear in the tarpaulin I glimpsed the night sky.

sentences.text: Starry and cloudless.
sentences.read: Starry and cloudless.

sentences.text: I undid the tarpaulin and lay on top of it.
